title: Noise sensitivity derivative at zero
statement: For any real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $\widehat f(S)$ denote its uniform Fourier coefficients and define $N_f(\delta)=\bigl(1-\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}(1-2\delta)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)^2\bigr)/2$. Define the total influence by $I(f)=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbb{E}[((f(x^{i,+})-f(x^{i,-}))/2)^2]$, where $x^{i,+}$ and $x^{i,-}$ are obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $+1$ and $-1$, respectively. Then $N_f'(0)=I(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
